form.name: Name

form.model_help: Members can switch models in the chat.
form.model_custom_id_help: The model ID exactly as the provider names it.
form.fallback_credentials_summary: Only used when neither the member nor the workspace has added a key in AI providers settings.
form.credentials_help: Values are write-only. Saved values stay hidden; replace one to change it.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.label: Anthropic API key
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.help: Used when neither the member nor the workspace has an Anthropic key. Or use a Claude Code OAuth token instead.

CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.label: Claude Code OAuth token
CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.help: A Claude subscription token, used when no API key is set.

OPENAI_API_KEY.label: OpenAI API key
OPENAI_API_KEY.help: Signs Codex in when its home is not already signed in.

PLANE_AGENT_EFFORT.label: Default reasoning effort
PLANE_AGENT_EFFORT.help: Optional, e.g. high. Used when the model takes that level. Members can switch it in the chat.

GEMINI_API_KEY.label: Gemini API key
GEMINI_API_KEY.help: Used when a member has no key of their own and isn't signed in with Google.

PLANE_AGENT_AUTH.label: Sign-in method
PLANE_AGENT_AUTH.help: Optional: api_key, chatgpt (Codex) or google_account (Gemini). Members' own credentials set it for their chats.

form.other_env_help: Set through the API. They are kept unless you remove them.
form.env_unreadable: The saved credentials cannot be decrypted (the instance secret key may have changed). Enter them again.
form.default_level_help: The level a new chat starts at.
form.max_level_help: Members cannot switch above this level.
form.attach_plane_mcp_help: Give the agent the Plane MCP server, acting as the member who chats.
form.is_enabled_help: Disabled agents are hidden from members.
